findings.message: 10 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 10 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "EST. GRAVATÁ" above "Seu estilo, nossa assinatura."; "Agendar este serviço" above "R$ 79,90"; "Corte + barboterapia" above "Boas mãos. Boas histórias."; "Corte infantil" above "Damião"; "Cristalização" above "Eduardo"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01 / 05", "01 / 06"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 16 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "GRAVATÁ · PE", "EST. GRAVATÁ", "UM LUGAR PARA VOLTAR", "SR. NAVALHA").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✦
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.sr-surface.sr-surface--fluted → repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 83px, rgba(186, 154, 117, 0.047) 83px,
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 12 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.hero-atelier-emblem → rgba(164, 123, 84, 0.125) 8px 9px 0px 0px | div.photo-window → rgba(48, 38, 32, 0.533) 3px 12px 24px -22px | div.photo-window → rgba(48, 38, 32, 0.533) 3px 12px 24px -22px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 4 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: 82 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): button.mirror-choice 389px | button.mirror-choice 389px | button.mirror-choice 389px | button.mirror-choice 389px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 14 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #f3eee5, section #f3eee5, text #f3eee5).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 90 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 12 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "A casa" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Serviços" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Nossa equipe" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "O trabalho" (screen 1, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "O próximo encontro é no Prado." → 3 lines (6 words, 32.8px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
